title: Instant Lead Reply
summary: Businesses pay for ads, then answer leads hours later and lose them. AI replies in 60 seconds, qualifies the lead and books the call.
hook: "They paid €30 for that lead on Facebook, then answered 6 hours later. The customer already booked someone else."
story:
**Mark runs a renovation company.** He spends €1,500/month on Google and Facebook ads. Leads come in through his website form, Facebook and WhatsApp while he's **on a job site with dirty hands**. He replies in the evening.

By then, half of those people have already called a competitor who answered first. He's paying for leads and **losing them because of speed**, not price or quality.

whyReal.title: Speed wins deals
whyReal.text: A well-known Harvard Business Review study found that companies contacting a lead within an hour were about 7× more likely to qualify it than those who waited longer. Many companies took over a day to reply.

whyReal.title: Wasted ad money is easy to see
whyReal.text: Owners know what they spend on ads, so "you're losing X leads a month" is a simple pitch.

whyReal.title: But: very crowded
whyReal.text: Lots of AI chat, receptionist and lead tools already exist. We only win with one narrow niche (one industry, one country, one language) that we serve better than anyone.

whyReal.title: Fastest to build
whyReal.text: Technically the simplest of the three. A working demo in 2–3 weeks.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: small businesses that run paid ads and sell high-value services: renovation, solar installers, clinics (dental, aesthetics), driving schools, real estate agents, coaches.

whoPays.label: Niche idea
whoPays.text: pick ONE vertical, e.g. "AI lead reply for solar installers" or "for dental clinics in Romania", and become the obvious choice there.

solution.title: Connect
solution.text: link the website form, Facebook Lead Ads, email and WhatsApp Business.

solution.title: Instant reply (<60 sec)
solution.text: AI answers in the business's name and language: "Hi Lucy, thanks for your request about a kitchen renovation!"

solution.title: Qualify
solution.text: it asks 2–3 smart questions (budget, location, timing) taken from the owner's own script.

solution.title: Book
solution.text: good leads get a calendar link and book a call or visit directly.

solution.title: Hand-off
solution.text: the owner gets a short summary on his phone: "Lucy, Manchester, €8–10K, wants to start in March, call booked Tue 10:00".

solution.title: Follow-up
solution.text: leads that go quiet get automatic follow-ups on days 1, 3 and 7.

timeline.what: **Pick the niche.** Jonatan calls 20 businesses in 2–3 industries and asks how fast they reply to leads.
Victor builds form + email capture, AI reply and calendar booking.
WhatsApp, notifications, dashboard. First 3 businesses on free trial.

pricing.name: Setup: $300
pricing.description: We write their script and connect everything

risks.answer: Only enter with a sharp niche (one industry plus one region).
Show the ROI every month: "we saved 14 leads = €X revenue".
Strict scripts, no prices or promises without owner rules.
Start with forms + email, add channels later.

questions: How many leads do you get per month, and from where?
How fast do you usually reply? Who replies?
How much do you spend on ads per month?
Do you think you lose customers because you reply late?
What tools do you use today to handle leads?
